newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Moldovan Foreign Minister Mihai Popov met his Romanian counterpart Adrian Severin to discuss issues of regional interest and boosting bilateral relations.
The two will hold a joint news conference at 1730 hours.
* Romania's Integration Minister Alexandru Herlea was awarded the membership of French Legion of Honour.

* The main opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) called on President Emil Constantinescu to put an end to ruling coalition's bid to appoint politically affiliated persons as bank presidents, subordinating the sector to politics.
A PDSR statement said the measure was anti-democratic and totalitarian and demanded that political purging in banks be curved. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
